search_notes: Checked 2026-10-02 UTC against the 90-day cutoff of 2026-07-04 UTC. Alphabetical order carries no ranking. For every listed repository, gh api repos/OWNER/REPO confirmed existence, canonical URL, and archived=false; gh api repos/OWNER/REPO/releases/latest confirmed a release inside the window. READMEs supplied deployment and functional evidence. OpenLLMetry was excluded because its [README](https://github.com/traceloop/openllmetry#readme) describes instrumentation extensions requiring a separate backend. Phoenix passed the maintenance checks but was excluded under an open-source license interpretation because its [README](https://github.com/Arize-ai/phoenix#copyright-patent-and-license) specifies Elastic License 2.0. Agenta passed maintenance checks, but OpenTelemetry ingestion was not established by its inspected [README](https://github.com/Agenta-AI/agenta#readme). The entries provide storage and inspection within one product deployment, including their storage dependencies. Suitability for the primary host is inferred from documented local deployments; native macOS arm64 deployment was not fully verified. Used 6 search requests, 8 successful README page fetches, and 30 GitHub API calls. This bounded discovery set does not establish exhaustive coverage of all public repositories.
